text:
Janet K.: Heads-up: audit scan found vault transit metadata (wrapped_key_id) leaking into staging logs (gs://staging-telemetry/2026-04-10.log).
Leo (platform): paste snippet?
Janet K.: `...transit:{wrapped_key_id:\"projects/redwood-kms/keys/wrap-2026-01\", iv:\"b64..\"}, obj:123`
Maya R.: that wrapped_key_id is an identifier but not a key material. still sensitive because it narrows key target. treat as incident.
Omar (sec): agreed. triage steps: 1) identify all objects with transit metadata, 2) revoke/rotate any service creds that wrote those logs, 3) create new wrap key and plan rewrap if ciphertext present, 4) tighten bucket IAM and logging filters.
Leo (platform): running quick grep across backup prefixes now.
VaultBot: automated scan: 5 objects matched pattern /transit:\{wrapped_key_id:.+\}/ in last 60 days.
Janet K.: probable cause: agent debug serializes envelope metadata into logs. check backup-agent and vault client wrappers.
Maya R.: can someone grep agent repo for "wrapped_key_id" or "envelope"?
Leo (platform): `git grep -n "wrapped_key_id" || true` -> infra/backup-agent/pkg/encrypt/logging.go:48: log.Debugf("envelope=%s", envelope)
Maya R.: yep debug logging. helm staging values had LOG_LEVEL=debug.
Omar (sec): action owners: Leo -> remove logs + purge objects; Maya -> KMS rotation plan; Janet -> audit export & timeline + legal hold if needed.
Leo (platform): purging matched objects now. bucket versioning note: will open GCS ticket for force-delete of old versions.
VaultBot: scheduled delete job queued (job id: jd-20260410-09).
Maya R.: KMS proposal: create wrap-2026-02, update agent to use new key, re-run backups under maintenance window, mark old key for destruction after 72h if no unwraps.
Omar (sec): also require that agent strips envelope metadata from logs; add CI lint to fail if env LOG_LEVEL=debug in helm values for non-dev clusters.
Janet K.: scanning for related Vault audit entries to see if any external reads coincided.
Leo (platform): RBAC tweak: remove domain:devs@... from viewer on staging-backups, add group:backup-ops only. patching helm values to LOG_LEVEL=info and redeploying.
Maya R.: scan results: no partner data in affected objects; internal-only staging. still rotate to be safe.
Omar (sec): created ticket INFSEC-612 for full rotation + postmortem. add audit export links and rewrap script.
Janet K.: summary: leak came from debug logging of envelope metadata, not KMS compromise. containment in progress: purge, RBAC, rotation. will update once rewrap completes.
Maya R.: thanks. closing loop after INFSEC-612 is updated. :lock:
